_comment: What this coach offers, as the website intends to sell it.
This file is the source of truth for the SITE. The LAB is the source of
truth for the ACCOUNT. `manage.py lab_catalogue` reports where the two
disagree, and what to go and ask when a service is described too thinly
for The LAB to hold it.
Copy this file per coach. Nothing in it is specific to the code.

services.title: 1v1 Session
services.description: One player, one hour, full attention. The ball never stops moving.

services.title: Small Group
services.description: Three or four players. Competitive reps, real tempo, nowhere to hide.

services.title: Film Session
services.description: Filmed training, then the clips back with the reasons attached.

blocks.title: Six-Week Block
blocks.description: One session a week for six weeks, with work set for the hours in between.
